note: Commercial Bank of Qatar's Classic card, issued against a salary transferred to the bank: an annual fee of 250 riyals after a free first year, the next year's waived on 9,000 riyals of purchases in the year before, written as a waiver on that spending; retail balances bear 1% a month (its tariff of charges, last updated 27 September 2026). A card held without a salary transfer is priced at the bank's discretion.

sources.title: Commercial Bank, Classic Credit Card
sources.said: Annual Fees: *QAR 250 (Waived for the first year). *Spend a minimum of QAR 9,000 using your card during the first year on daily purchases
